scope: Published Android release .6 on the owned official Windows emulator with the existing 98e419f7 local service: real permission denial, guest-only network interruption, connection recovery and foreground/background microphone privacy. Not host network or new server deployment acceptance.

android.environment: Official Emulator 37.2.13.0 build 16740729; owned StreamKit_API_36 AVD on Windows 11

permission_denial.permission_restored_for_next_scenario: Official adb pm grant on owned AVD; not represented as a UI permission-grant acceptance

guest_network_recovery.method: svc wifi disable and svc data disable in the owned Android guest only

evidence.source: Actual local API/ADB command observations from the controlled execution; no CI run is attributed

earlier_fixture_attempts: An initial check sampled admission before it became ready and failed with zero generations; the fixture was corrected to wait for the real admission state.

A subsequent check selected only the first-denial Android resource ID. The actual dialog used the permanent-denial resource ID; that attempt was not marked as a permission-denial pass. The later successful execution used the actual Android dialog.
limits: Old local Windows service compatibility only; no automatic extension to 40146db2 deployment or exact new terminal semantics.
AVD radio toggles do not establish physical radio, host DHCP/IP change, whole host reboot or Bluetooth behavior.
Privacy state and actual authority/connection lifetime were checked. This scenario did not measure a new acoustic sample or repeat program-audio acceptance.
The separately recorded signed-APK audio/revocation execution supplies the actual sound measurements.
